verdict: Meta is delivering leads; Google's spend is producing nothing and is being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 36 leads at $104.87 per lead — every single one came from Meta, while Google Ads spent $1,997 and produced zero conversions. Google's search campaigns are confirmed as the priority issue: spend is being reduced there while the conversion tracking and campaign structure are corrected. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile had a strong week, up 33% in actions versus the prior 7 days, which is a positive sign for local visibility. Leads entering your pipeline are not converting to appointments, so alongside the ad corrections, intake follow-up is being reviewed to close that gap. Next period you should see Google either producing measurable results or spend redirected toward what is working.
